turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Let me show you how I think.
"Apple" begins with a vowel sound. So I say: She eats an apple.
So, the rule is: an goes before a vowel sound; a goes before other sounds.
Good: I have a pen. Not good: I have an pen.

Now it is your turn. Write only the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
